_comment: One element of the `data[]` array from GET /api/tiktok-shop/integration-instances/{id}/listing-quality. This is the exact resource shape the skill reads: the TikTok product plus its latest cached diagnosis. `id` is the row id the diagnose-one path takes; `tiktok_product_id` is the remote id the Edit Product write would take. `diagnoses[].seo_words` is already flattened to a string list (from TikTok's suggestion.seo_words[].text).
title: Cotton Dress

diagnosis_results.how_to_solve: Names must be at least 40 characters long.
Add a detailed description of at least 300 characters covering materials, fit and care.
Add more images and make the first image a product shot on a plain white background.
